summary: The pre-sign worker's light service sets BUILD_ADMISSION_CLASS=light, so the nix develop of the light checks' dev shells takes the build wrapper's light class instead of a heavy admission ticket; the heavy service is unchanged.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

compatibility.detail: Needs the build wrapper that honours BUILD_ADMISSION_CLASS (installed on the signing host); elsewhere the variable is ignored.

manual.detail: Operations reinstalls ~/.config/systemd/user/evidence-presign-light.service from the merge commit and runs systemctl --user daemon-reload.

recovery.detail: Revert the pull request and reinstall the unit.
